title: Gedaliah
lead: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, grandson of the royal secretary Shaphan, was the man Babylon put in charge of the people left in Judah after 586 BC. He ruled from Mizpah, was murdered in the seventh month by Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and his death sent the survivors to Egypt. Jews mark it with the Fast of Gedaliah on the third of Tishri.
